notes: Lead from inbound form (support automation category). CTO: "we need deterministic outputs for triage and ticket fields — structured JSON is must". Small engineering org, wants self-serve first then expand. Use-cases: 1) auto-summarize incoming tickets to 3-line TL;DR + tags; 2) generate structured triage fields (priority, product, category) via tool-calling to update internal ticket system; 3) agent-assist with suggested replies and canned summaries. Latency/throughput: median response <400ms for single ticket summary, burst up to 150 qps during morning ingest windows. Cost sensitivity: high — tight margins; interested in batching and caching recommendations. Model preferences: small/med open models preferred (Llama2/other open weights), but open to higher-capacity variants if cost-effective; wants model routing by latency/cost. Security: requires SOC2 type2, SSO, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS for production keys. Current stack: Postgres + custom ticketing, webhook-based ingest, supports webhooks and REST, no VPC yet. Timeline: wants 2-week POC to validate accuracy and latency, then self-serve subscription. AE notes: gave hosted API quickstart link, offered $500 credit for POC. Quoted next steps and risks. POC success criteria: 85% precision on category assignment, avg summary length 30-50 words, end-to-end latency under 500ms.
